texts.zh: 这场灾难几乎是彻底的，但仍有一些零散的记录保存了下来。似乎[From.Planet.GetName]的人们因为外星人正在观察他们的想法而感到困扰。不明飞行物出现、动物残害和绑架的频繁报道，使得这颗星球陷入了疯狂。作为他们对观察的回应，无数的资源被投入到巨型的探测阵列、反宇宙飞船防御系统和地下庇护所上，以保护人民。
texts.en: The devastation is almost total, but a few scattered records have survived. It seems that the people of [From.Planet.GetName] were obsessed with the idea that aliens were observing them. Frequent reports of Unidentified Flying Objects, animal mutilation, and abductions drove the planet into a frenzy. In reaction countless resources were poured into vast detection arrays, anti-spacecraft defenses, and underground shelters to protect the population.

texts.zh: 从零散的记录中我们拼凑出了更多的细节。随着星球上越来越多的资源被投入到毫无成果的反不明飞行物措施中，他们的经济和社会开始崩溃。很多地区出现了电力不足与粮食短缺的现象，大多数领域的科技发展停滞不前，一股深深的绝望感弥漫在社会各阶层之中。在散乱的信息中我们发现了某种"终极护盾"，这种护盾随着[From.Planet.GetName]上情况局势恶化也变得越来越普及。
texts.en: More details have been assembled from the scattered records we have recovered. As an ever-increasing percentage of planetary resources were poured into anti-UFO measures without any noticeable success their economy and society began to collapse. Brownouts and food shortages were endemic, most fields of technology stagnated, and a deep sense of hopelessness prevailed at every level of society. Scattered references have been found to some kind of "ultimate shield", which become increasingly common as reports about the general situation on [From.Planet.GetName] get worse.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh: 从一座坚固的军事基地发现的残破的数据库中我们得知了[From.Planet.GetName]的悲惨命运。由于经济全面崩盘，他们的反不明飞行物措施完全停摆，[From.Planet.GetName]的统治者们启动了他们的"终极护盾"。然而这并不是一个用以保护[From.Planet.GetName]的护罩，相反它是对人口与基础设施的一次彻底的核毁灭，来确保这两者都不会被外来入侵者占领。他们做出这一决定显然是受到了来自[arc_anomaly_planet.GetName]的“外星人信号”的刺激。
texts.en: The discovery of a partially preserved databank in a hardened military bunker has revealed the sad fate of [From.Planet.GetName]. Faced with a general economic collapse which would have lead to the end of their anti-UFO measures, the rulers of [From.Planet.GetName] activated their "ultimate shield". However, this was not a shield to protect [From.Planet.GetName], rather it was the complete nuclear annihilation of the population and infrastructure to ensure neither could be taken by alien invaders. This decision was apparently spurred on by the discovery of an "alien signal" coming from [arc_anomaly_planet.GetName].

summary.text:
# 废墟 / Ruins

- 分类 Category：先驱者与考古 Precursors · 来源 Sources：common/archaeological_site_types/02_ancient_relics_arc_sites.txt:1619；events/ancient_relics_arcsite_events_1.txt:796 · DLC：《远古遗物》Ancient Relics · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

勘察天体时，隐藏事件 ancrel.9999（on_survey_planet）以 5/405 的机会生成一个随机考古遗址（AI帝国或5年内刚发现过遗址者机会×0.2），再按各遗址的权重抽取；本遗址要求拥有《远古遗物》，权重60，出现在可居住星球上。全银河最多一处。

When a body is surveyed, hidden ancrel.9999 (on_survey_planet) has a 5/405 chance to create a random dig site (×0.2 for AI empires or if a site was found in the last 5 years), then picks a site type by weight; this site needs Ancient Relics and has weight 60 on habitable planets. At most one per galaxy.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

一颗被地下核爆毁灭的星球：其居民痴迷于外星人监视，把越来越多资源投入防御，最终启动“终极护盾”——对自己的星球进行核毁灭，免得被外星人夺取。

1. 穿墟而行：对不明飞行物的狂热和庞大的反外星防御
2. 发现记录：经济崩溃，提到“终极护盾”
3. 揭示命运：被保存的军事数据库揭示：护盾就是对本星球的彻底核打击（反点防科技选项25%、社会学研究、中型文物）

A world destroyed by underground nuclear blasts: its people were obsessed with alien observers, poured resources into defences, and finally triggered an "ultimate shield" — nuking themselves so no invader could take the planet.

1. Sifting Through the Wreckage: frenzy over UFO reports and vast anti-alien defences
2. Records Discovered: economic collapse and talk of an "ultimate shield"
3. Fate Uncovered: a bunker databank: the shield was total nuclear annihilation of their own world (point-defence tech option 25%, society research, medium artifact)
